events.what: Improved explicit upper bounds on H_n for small dimensions (H5<=933, H6<=6137, H7<=41377, H8<=284096)
Arman, Kaire, Prymak prove Hadwiger's covering conjecture for cap bodies in all dimensions
Single-author preprint claims the optimal exponential growth rate of the covering number as n->infinity
events.credibility_reason: Days old; the record finds no academic footprint for the author; an optimal asymptotic rate would be a major advance. Too little time has passed for silence to count as a not_credible signal.

judgement.doubts: The record's event, credited_humans and direction already describe the cap-bodies result; only the status was held back to 'progress' by a judgement that the case is narrow, which §4 does not allow — a settled case is partial whatever its size. The Gorodzha preprint is a bound at most and cannot outrank partial; its fate is unknown. The record could not rule out an AI disclosure in its body.

corrections.why: F3/other: the record itself says arXiv:2510.25968 'confirms Hadwiger's conjecture for the restricted class of cap bodies in all dimensions' and calls it 'a genuine restricting case'. Settling a case is tier partial, which outranks the progress tier of the 2404.00547 bounds. Its competing_reading already argued for this code.
